PRIVACY & DATA CHOICES

A public address.
A limited footprint.

SiteBuddy Free gives an informational view of public map context. Please do not enter confidential candidate addresses, customer details or private business information.

When you analyze a location

After your explicit consent and submission, Photon receives the address to find possible matches. After you confirm one, Overture's public catalog and object storage receive nearby tile requests that reveal the approximate area. Those providers receive network information such as IP addresses and may retain their own logs. SiteBuddy does not keep a server-side address history or write searches to cookies or browser storage. Results and a short provider cache stay in page memory and disappear when the page closes.

When you share or save

The default shared summary contains only the rubric version, date, source kind and three scores. No address or coordinates are included. The summary sits in the link fragment, which ordinary HTTP requests do not send to the server; the person or service you share the complete link with can see it. The summary is editable and is not independently verified. A saved replay snapshot is different: it includes the address, coordinates and normalized observations. Keep that file private when appropriate.

Optional measurement

Measurement is off by default on every page load. If you opt in, a first-party endpoint receives fixed action names, broad source/channel labels, synthetic-versus-public status, selected future-category labels and broad failure categories. It never receives your searched address, coordinates, email, raw referring URL or score. A random ID identifies each event for duplicate protection; it is not a persistent visitor ID. Daily counts and event IDs are kept in private Netlify storage and scheduled for removal after 30 days. Service failures can delay cleanup. Counts cannot be tied back to a person for individual deletion. Turning measurement off stops future events and aborts pending requests; already received counts remain until cleanup.

Voluntary feedback and Early Access interest

Fixed choices and an optional email go to separate private Netlify storage, with scheduled deletion after 90 days. Email requires separate permission to contact you. No searched address is attached. No automatic email is sent. Future professional capabilities are ideas, not available services. Only fixed success/category events enter analytics, and only with separate measurement consent. Form values stay in page memory when submission fails so you can retry; starting another analysis clears them.

Hosting and access

Netlify hosts the app and private submission storage. It processes connection information and security logs under its own policies. Storage is available to authorized members of the owner's Netlify team, not through a public read API. No advertising trackers, geolocation, payment details or private scoring system are used. SiteBuddy does not sell or expose submissions through this app. Hosting and data-provider availability are outside this experiment's control.

Questions or removal requests

There is no self-service contact-record deletion in this experiment. To request a private contact channel from the owner, open a repository issue containing only that request. Do not include your email, confidential addresses, snapshots or other personal information in a public issue. Once a private channel is arranged, the owner can locate a volunteered email in Netlify and remove its record. Scheduled deletion also applies.

Updated 7 October 2026. This page describes this implementation; it does not promise that independent providers keep no logs.

Owner notifications and exports

Private Netlify records remain the primary record. The owner-notification integration is disabled until account and sender approval. When enabled, Resend receives opted-in contact details and submitted role/capability choices for delivery only to the fixed site owner. Feedback and anonymous interest contribute to aggregate daily digests. No searched address, coordinates or replay is included. No automatic email is sent to visitors. Resend and the receiving email provider process message contents; provider retention and owner inbox copies are separate from Netlify deletion. Delivery metadata is deleted after 91 days, operational counts after 30 days, and submissions after 90 days. Private owner exports exclude test data by default and should be deleted after use. Storage failure counts are operational diagnostics, not visitor tracking.
